text:
Alex: Kicking off a micro-canary for service inference v2.1.2 -> deploy started, 1% traffic to eu-west-1. Change window 17:00-18:00 PT. DeployBot: canary created (id: cb-1758000000).
Maria: Confirming release notes link? and that 2.1.2 is pinned to the canary pool?
Alex: Release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/2.1.2 short: batch kernel tweaks + kv-cache guard. Yes pinned to pool `canary-eu-small` for now.
Jin: Quick FYI — last small canary we saw KV cache mem pressure on p3-small with long-context requests. Any mem limit changes?
SREBot: alert: redispatcher-prod eu-west-1 memory spike 15:03 UTC — 2m ago (observed 78% -> 92%). Context: unrelated traffic, but flagging.
Tara: Can we start with concurrency 2 and token cap 1024 for the canary? That should reduce tail memory.
Alex: Doing that now: updating runtime config: `concurrency:2, max_tokens:1024`
DeployBot: config applied to cb-1758000000: concurrency=2, max_tokens=1024.
Paul: Recommend we hold at 1% for 12 minutes and check latency, error-rate, p95 memory. If stable -> move to 5%. If any error-rate > 0.5% or p95 latency +20% -> rollback.
Maria: Who will execute rollback if needed? Prefer ops to do immediate rollback; devs to assist.
Tara: I'll own rollback. Plan: DeployBot rollback command `deploybot rollback cb-1758000000` will restore pool to v2.1.1. I have access.
Jin: Also adding an automated safeguard: if `kv_cache_evictions > 10/min` or `oom_count > 0` -> auto-pause traffic shift.
DeployBot: safety hook set: kv_cache_evictions>10/min OR oom_count>0 -> pause_shift.
Alex: Observability panels synced: link https://dashboards/redwood/canary/1758000000 watch p95, errors, kv_evictions, oom.
Maria: lgtm on procedure. Notifying product and CS about potential transient errors.
(5m pass)
SREBot: metric snapshot: errors=0.12%, p95 latency +6%, kv_evictions=0, oom_count=0.
Paul: Metrics look within thresholds. Recommend proceed to 5%. Any objections?
Jin: no objections from infra. Proceed but keep concurrency cap.
Tara: Proceeding: DeployBot traffic-shift 1% -> 5% now.
DeployBot: traffic-shift initiated: 1% -> 5% (cb-1758000000). Estimated 90s.
(2m later)
SREBot: post-shift metrics: errors=0.15%, p95 +8%, kv_evictions=1/min, oom_count=0. No automatic pause triggered.
Maria: Good. Update release notes with canary status: "2.1.2: 5% canary in eu-west-1, monitoring"
Alex: I'll open a short post-deploy check thread at +30m to confirm go/no-go for broader rollout. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Tara: Thanks — I'll keep watch and will execute rollback if kv_evictions spike or oom appears.
Paul: Marking this canary as pinned to `canary-eu-small` while at 5%.
